body: Get 102 common internet marketing terms explained in plain English, A to Z, to help you navigate the online world with clarity.
caption: Feeling confused by all the different marketing words out there? You're not alone! 🤔 The online world has its own language, and it can be tough to keep up. That's why we created 'The Internet Marketing Dictionary'. It's a free guide with 102 marketing terms, all explained in simple, plain English from A to Z. No more guessing what SEO or ROI means.
